summary: Jay Fai is a celebrated street-side wok restaurant in Bangkok's Phra Nakhon old town, known for its crisp, crab-filled omelette and other seafood and noodle dishes. Expect a high-priced destination meal, cash payment and time spent queuing or standing.
whyGo: The charcoal wok cooking and street-side setting are part of the experience, and the crab omelette is the signature dish.
MICHELIN describes an organised queue and also recommends stir-fried prawns in yellow curry and noodle dishes.
Its Maha Chai Road address fits a Phra Nakhon or Old Town day out.
bestFor: Visitors who want to try Bangkok's best-known crab omelette and can make a meal of it
Seafood fans who are comfortable paying substantially more than at an ordinary street-food stall
Travelers with a flexible schedule who enjoy watching open-kitchen cooking
skipIf: You have crab, shellfish or egg allergies, or need confirmed allergen separation
You need a quick, low-cost meal or cannot stand in a queue
You require verified step-free access, accessible toilets or a quiet indoor dining room
duration: Allow 1–3 hours for the queue and meal; this is a planning estimate, and waits vary.
cost: MICHELIN lists the restaurant as ฿฿฿ but publishes no dish prices. Thai PBS reported in August 2025 that the crab omelette appeared on the menu at THB 1,500, with a THB 4,000 special preparation also offered. Treat these as reported 2025 prices, check the posted menu and confirm the price for your exact order before ordering. MICHELIN lists cash only.
hours: MICHELIN's listing checked 17 October 2026 shows Wednesday–Saturday, 09:00–19:30; closed Sunday–Tuesday. These are current listed hours, not a guarantee for December holiday dates; reconfirm before travelling.
bestTime: Plan a flexible morning or lunch visit and allow for a wait; avoid placing it between timed attractions. Check the booking link before setting out, and arrive early if you expect to join the walk-in queue.
gettingThere: At 327 Maha Chai Road, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon. The Tourism Authority of Thailand identifies MRT Sam Yot as the nearby station; continue on foot or by taxi and use a live map for the final approach.
booking: MICHELIN currently links to a Chope reservation page for Jay Fai, alongside the restaurant phone number +66 2 223 9384. Check availability and current terms directly; if you do not have a booking, expect to queue. Bring cash, as MICHELIN lists cash only.
accessibility: MICHELIN says guests should expect to stand in line. The sources reviewed do not confirm step-free entry, accessible toilets, queue accommodations or seating layout; contact the restaurant before visiting if any of these are essential.
practicalTips: Check the current menu and confirm the price of the specific crab omelette before it is prepared; published accounts distinguish the standard dish from a special-priced order.
Bring enough cash; card payment is not listed by MICHELIN.
Ask staff directly about crab, shellfish, egg, sauces and cross-contact if you have an allergy; allergen procedures were not verified.
Allow a flexible block of time and avoid scheduling a timed attraction immediately afterward.
The omelette is best eaten fresh; a long takeaway journey can soften its crisp exterior.
decemberNotes: No special December 2026 service or event was found. The current MICHELIN schedule is Wednesday–Saturday, but holiday hours and booking availability may differ; check the Chope link or call shortly before your visit, especially around Christmas and New Year.
uncertainties: Hours and booking availability may change before December 2026, including on public holidays.
Current menu prices and the distinction between standard and special preparation were not confirmed directly with the restaurant; cited prices were reported in 2025.
Queue length, detailed accessibility and allergy handling are not specified in the sources reviewed.
